pro arguments provided: pro: Private prisons provide innovative strategies to reduce recidivism. pro: Private prisons have the potential to reform the failing government-run jail system. pro: Privatizing prisons can reduce prison overpopulation, making the facilities safer for inmates and employees.

Those in favor of private prisons say they offer innovative programs that can actually reduce the re-incarnation rate. They also claim that they can help to reform the broken prison system. However, on the other hand, people who are against private prisons say that all prisons, not just private ones, should be abolished. They also say that privatizing prisons is very expensive and ultimately leaves the most expensive prisoners to public prisons.
